about.title: Find where to dance and who to learn from
about.intro: SomosSalsa brings dance events, festivals, academies, artists, venues, and community resources together so they are easier to find.
about.missionTitle: What we want to make easier
about.missionText: We want anyone to discover what is happening, where to learn, and where to dance without relying on scattered information. SomosSalsa started in Guatemala and is built to grow city by city, giving academies, organizers, artists, and venues the same space.
about.sourcesIntro: We gather material shared publicly or submitted for promotion:
about.sourcesPublic: Public flyers and posts from organizers, academies, teachers, and venues.
about.sourcesDirect: Information sent directly by people responsible for an activity or profile.
about.sourcesCommunity: Community contributions submitted through SomosSalsa's public forms.
about.reviewTitle: How we take care of the information
about.reviewText: Artificial intelligence may help us read flyers and organize details, but a person reviews information before publication. We prioritize dates, times, prices, locations, responsible parties, and contact methods that can be verified.
about.reviewDates: Events automatically leave the current calendar after they end.
about.reviewRelations: Relationships between events, academies, artists, organizers, and venues are published only when the match is sufficiently reliable.
about.reviewExpired: Some past events remain available as a historical reference; thin records are not offered for indexing.
about.correctionsText: Details may change after publication. If you organize an activity, represent a listed profile, or find incorrect information, you can request a correction by writing to
about.independenceText: SomosSalsa is an independent platform: it does not belong to any academy, does not organize listed events, and does not currently sell tickets. Flyers and images belong to their respective authors. Before attending or paying, we recommend confirming current details with the organizer.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy policy
privacyPolicy.intro: This policy explains what information SomosSalsa processes, why it is used, and what choices you have when you visit the site or submit content.
privacyPolicy.controllerText: SomosSalsa is operated by GuatCloud, an independent project active in Guatemala. GuatCloud manages the processing of information received through {domain}.
privacyPolicy.controllerContact: For privacy questions, corrections, or requests related to your data, email
privacyPolicy.essentialStorage: Necessary preferences: we store your language and analytics choice so the site remembers how you want to use it.
privacyPolicy.analyticsData: Optional analytics: if you accept, Google Analytics 4 processes visited pages, interactions, browser or device data, and approximate geographic location. SomosSalsa does not send names, email addresses, or phone numbers to Analytics.
privacyPolicy.advertisingData: Advertising: the site integrates Google AdSense. Google and authorized vendors may use cookies, identifiers, web beacons, IP addresses, or similar technologies to serve, limit, and measure ads, depending on their configuration and your choices.
privacyPolicy.submissionsData: Public forms: we may receive names, descriptions, dates, schedules, locations, images, social profiles, phone numbers, contact links, and promotional text for events, academies, artists, venues, or community resources. A recommendation may also include the private name and email of the person who submitted it.
privacyPolicy.incidentsData: Problem reports: we retain the form type, the step where the problem occurred, a technical message, and an incident code. We do not request passwords or financial information.
privacyPolicy.communicationsData: Communications: if you email us, we process the address and content needed to respond.
privacyPolicy.publicSourcesText: We also organize information published for promotion by organizers, academies, artists, festivals, venues, shops, and service providers on official websites, social media, or promotional material shared directly. We do not assume that everything in an account or private conversation is public.
privacyPolicy.publicSourcesRemoval: If you represent a person or organization mentioned and want information corrected or removed, email
privacyPolicy.aiText: Forms may use Google Gemini to extract details from a flyer or promotional text. Analysis may detect artists, academies, organizers, or venues and flag them for admin review. AI does not publish profiles or relationships on its own.
privacyPolicy.aiAdvice: Do not submit private documents, passwords, financial data, or sensitive information that is unnecessary for promoting an activity or profile.
privacyPolicy.localText: Forms may keep a draft of fields and text in your browser's local storage for seven days to help recover your work. Images are not kept in that draft. Nothing is submitted for publication until you press the submit button.
privacyPolicy.purposePublish: Review, publish, and maintain events, festivals, academies, artists, venues, and community resources.
privacyPolicy.purposeRelations: Connect activities to responsible parties and locations when the match can be verified.
privacyPolicy.purposeOperate: Prevent duplicates, investigate errors, protect the service, and respond to requests.
privacyPolicy.purposeMeasure: Measure site usage and improve the experience when you accept analytics.
privacyPolicy.purposeAds: Display and measure advertising that helps fund the site.
privacyPolicy.providersIntro: We do not sell your personal information. We use providers that process data under their own terms and policies to operate the service:
privacyPolicy.providerSupabase: Supabase for databases, image storage, and backend services.
privacyPolicy.providerVercel: Vercel for hosting, distribution, and technical application logs.
privacyPolicy.providerGoogle: Google for Gemini, Analytics, and AdSense.
privacyPolicy.internationalText: These providers may process information in countries other than your own. We use available settings and reasonable measures to limit processing to what is necessary.
privacyPolicy.googleDataLink: How Google uses data from partner sites
privacyPolicy.publicationText: Promotional information that is submitted and approved may be shown publicly, including professional names, images, schedules, locations, and profile contact methods. The name and email identified as the private contact for a resource recommendation are not published. Before submitting someone else's information, confirm that you have permission to share it.
privacyPolicy.retentionText: We retain submissions, publications, and operational records while needed to review content, maintain useful references, handle requests, or protect the service. Some past events may remain as a historical archive. We use reasonable security measures, but no internet-connected system can guarantee zero risk.
privacyPolicy.choiceAccess: You may request access, correction, or deletion of information you submitted or that publicly identifies you.
privacyPolicy.choiceConsent: You may decline Google Analytics from the privacy notice. The choice is stored in your browser.
privacyPolicy.choiceBrowser: You may also delete or block cookies and local storage through your browser settings.
privacyPolicy.minorsText: SomosSalsa is not specifically directed at children and does not knowingly request private information from them. If you believe information about a child was published without permission, contact us so we can review it.
privacyPolicy.changesText: We may update this policy when the service, its providers, or applicable requirements change. The new revision date will be published on this page.
privacyPolicy.contactText: To exercise a choice, request a correction, or ask a privacy question, email

termsPolicy.title: Terms of use
termsPolicy.intro: These terms govern access to and use of SomosSalsa. By using the site or submitting content, you agree to these conditions.
termsPolicy.operatorText: SomosSalsa is operated by GuatCloud, an independent project active in Guatemala. You can contact us at
termsPolicy.serviceText: SomosSalsa is an information platform for finding events, festivals, academies, artists, venues, and resources related to salsa, bachata, and Latin dance. Guatemala is the first active location, but coverage may grow to other cities and countries.
termsPolicy.independenceText: SomosSalsa is not an academy, does not organize listed activities, and does not currently process payments or sell tickets. When we display a contact or purchase link, the relationship is directly with the organizer or external provider.
termsPolicy.sourcesText: Some information comes from official websites, public posts, and material shared for promotion. Flyers, photographs, trademarks, and original copy belong to their respective owners. Their inclusion identifies and describes an activity and does not claim authorship.
termsPolicy.correctionText: If you are an owner or representative and want content corrected, credited, or removed, email
termsPolicy.submissionsText: By submitting content, you confirm that the information is reasonably accurate, that you may share it, and that contact details were provided for promotion. You authorize us to store, review, summarize, translate, adapt it to the site's format, and publish it to promote the activity or profile.
termsPolicy.moderationText: We may reject, edit, unpublish, or remove content that is incomplete, duplicated, misleading, unlawful, outdated, or contrary to the service's purpose.
termsPolicy.aiText: We may use artificial intelligence tools to read flyers, suggest fields, translate, or detect possible relationships between profiles. Results may contain errors and are subject to review. AI does not replace confirming details with the organizer.
termsPolicy.accuracyText: Dates, prices, schedules, artists, venues, and conditions may change after publication. We make reasonable efforts to keep information useful, but do not guarantee that it is complete or current. Always confirm details with the responsible party before attending, traveling, or paying.
termsPolicy.ticketsText: SomosSalsa is not responsible for payments, refunds, cancellations, availability, products, or services offered by third parties. External sites have their own terms and policies. Linking to a site does not guarantee or endorse its operation.
termsPolicy.conductIntro: When using SomosSalsa, you agree not to:
termsPolicy.conductFalse: Impersonate a person or organization or knowingly submit false information.
termsPolicy.conductRights: Publish material that violates third-party rights, privacy, or intellectual property.
termsPolicy.conductSecurity: Interfere with security, automate abusive requests, or attempt to access restricted areas.
termsPolicy.conductMisuse: Use the service for harassment, fraud, spam, or unlawful activity.
termsPolicy.intellectualText: The SomosSalsa name, visual identity, design, code, and original editorial content belong to GuatCloud or are used with permission. You may not copy or present the service as your own except as allowed by law.
termsPolicy.availabilityText: We may modify, suspend, or remove features for maintenance, security, or product development. We do not guarantee uninterrupted availability or an error-free site.
termsPolicy.liabilityText: To the extent allowed by law, GuatCloud is not responsible for decisions based solely on third-party content, event changes, losses from external transactions, or interruptions outside our control.
termsPolicy.complaintsText: For questions, corrections, or complaints about the site, email
termsPolicy.diacoText: If you are a consumer in Guatemala, you may also consult the channels of the Consumer Assistance Directorate (DIACO).
termsPolicy.changesText: We may update these terms when the service changes. The current version and revision date will be available on this page.
termsPolicy.lawText: These terms are interpreted under the laws of the Republic of Guatemala, without limiting mandatory rights that may apply based on your location.
